jobs.title: Factory/ Plant Head
jobs.description:
**Job Description – Plant Head / Factory Head**
**Location:**
Tumkur, Karnataka
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Tech in Dairy Technology or Dairy Science (Dairy Technologist)
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Plant Head / Factory Head to lead our dairy manufacturing operations at Tumkur. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in dairy processing, production management, quality assurance, operational excellence and team leadership.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end plant operations, ensuring production efficiency, maintaining quality and food safety standards, optimizing costs and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plant & Production Operations
* Oversee end-to-end dairy plant operations, including milk procurement coordination, processing, production, packaging and dispatch.
* Ensure production plans are executed efficiently to meet business requirements and delivery schedules.
* Monitor plant capacity utilization, production yields, wastage and operational efficiency.
* Ensure smooth functioning of processing equipment, utilities and production lines.
* Quality & Food Safety
* Ensure adherence to FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, hygiene protocols and quality management systems.
* Drive quality control measures across all stages of dairy processing and packaging.
* Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to minimize product deviations, rejections and customer complaints.
* Ensure implementation of HACCP, GMP, GHP and other relevant food safety practices.
* Cost & Process Optimization
* Monitor and control manufacturing costs, material consumption, utilities and operational expenses.
* Identify opportunities to improve production yields, reduce wastage and optimize resource utilization.
* Implement process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.
* Team & People Management
* Lead and manage production, maintenance, engineering and other plant teams.
* Build a performance-driven culture with clear accountability across functions.
* Identify training requirements and develop the technical capabilities of the plant workforce.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and workforce productivity.
* Maintenance & Compliance
* Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance activities to ensure maximum equipment uptime.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory and environmental compliance at the plant.
* Maintain operational records, audit documentation and reporting systems.
* Drive workplace safety and ensure adherence to EHS standards.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Coordinate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Sales and other business functions.
* Ensure alignment between production plans, raw material availability, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Present regular plant performance reports covering production, quality, costs and operational KPIs to management.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience in dairy manufacturing / dairy processing operations.
* Degree in Dairy Technology / Dairy Science is mandatory.
* Strong hands-on experience in managing end-to-end dairy plant operations.
* Experience in handling production processes such as milk processing, pasteurization, homogenization, chilling, fermentation and dairy product manufacturing.
* Good understanding of dairy quality standards, food safety regulations and statutory compliance.
* Proven experience in managing large plant teams and cross-functional operations.
* Strong expertise in production planning, cost control, process improvement and plant performance management.
* Candidates with prior experience independently managing a dairy plant or factory will be preferred.

**Key Skills:**
Dairy Processing | Plant Operations | Production Management | Quality Assurance | Food Safety | FSSAI | HACCP | GMP | Cost Optimization | Team Management | Plant Maintenance

jobs.title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
jobs.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.

* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

Role Overview
-------------

Vinca Cybertech is looking for a hands-on Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Resource to support the implementation, administration, monitoring and continuous improvement of DLP controls. The role will help protect sensitive business and customer information across endpoints, email, web and other data channels, while supporting incident investigation and policy compliance.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Configure, administer and monitor DLP policies for data at rest, data in use and data in motion.

* Support DLP solutions across endpoint, email, web and cloud environments, based on the deployed platform.

* Create, tune and maintain policies, rules, dictionaries, classifiers, fingerprints and exception lists to reduce false positives.

* Monitor DLP alerts and investigate potential data leakage incidents; validate events and document findings.

* Coordinate with IT, SOC, infrastructure, application and business teams to investigate and remediate incidents.

* Support data classification, sensitive-data discovery and mapping of controls to business requirements.

* Manage policy exceptions and change requests in line with approved procedures and security standards.

* Prepare incident reports, operational dashboards, compliance evidence and periodic status reports.

* Assist with DLP agent deployment, health checks, upgrades, troubleshooting and endpoint coverage reviews.

* Follow incident, change, access-control and escalation procedures; maintain accurate operational documentation.

Required Skills & Experience
----------------------------

* 2 4 years of relevant experience in DLP administration, information security or a related cybersecurity role.

jobs.title: Design Head - Electrical & Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION DESIGN HEAD**

  

**1. Position Details**

**Position:** Design Head – Electrical & Mechanical Engineering

**Function:** Engineering / Product Design & Development

**Experience:** 18+ years

**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical / Mechatronics Engineering; M.E./M.Tech preferred

**Level:** Senior Leadership

**Team Responsibility:** Mechanical Design, Electrical Design and Engineering teams

  

**2. Role Purpose**

Lead the overall **electrical and mechanical engineering design function**, ensuring robust, manufacturable, cost-effective and technically compliant designs from concept through industrialization.

The role requires a senior engineering leader with **18+ years of experience**, strong exposure to **both electrical engineering and mechanical design**, and demonstrated expertise in **sheet metal design and manufacturing processes**.

Experience in any specific product line is **not mandatory**. The emphasis is on strong engineering fundamentals, cross-functional design leadership, design governance, manufacturability, quality, cost optimization and team development.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Engineering & Design Leadership**

* Lead the end-to-end electrical and mechanical design engineering function.
* Establish engineering standards, design methodologies, technical guidelines and design governance processes.
* Drive concept development, detailed engineering, design validation and release of engineering documentation.
* Ensure designs meet requirements relating to **functionality, reliability, safety, manufacturability, serviceability, quality and cost**.
* Conduct and govern technical and design reviews at appropriate project milestones.
* Ensure timely closure of engineering issues during prototype, pilot and production stages.
* Provide technical direction for complex engineering problems and critical design decisions.
* Promote standardization, modular design, reuse of proven solutions and engineering best practices.

**B. Mechanical Design & Sheet Metal Engineering**

* Provide strong technical leadership in mechanical product design.
* **Lead design involving sheet metal components, assemblies, enclosures, cabinets, panels, frames and structural parts.**
* Ensure appropriate engineering consideration for:
* Sheet thickness and material selection
* Bend radius and bend allowance
* Tolerance stack-up
* GD&T
* Fastening and joining methods
* Welding
* Riveting and clinching
* Hardware selection
* Surface finishing and corrosion protection
* Structural strength and rigidity
* Design for assembly and serviceability
* Ensure effective **DFM/DFA (Design for Manufacturing / Design for Assembly)** considering actual manufacturing capability.
* Work closely with production teams on manufacturing processes such as **laser cutting, punching, bending, press brake operations, welding, powder coating and assembly**.
* Drive simplification of parts and assemblies to reduce manufacturing complexity and improve productivity.

**C. Electrical Engineering**

* Provide engineering leadership for electrical design and integration with mechanical systems.
* Review electrical architecture, electrical schematics, component selection and engineering documentation.
* Ensure appropriate selection and application of electrical components based on functional, safety and reliability requirements.
* Guide engineering teams on:
* Power distribution
* Control circuitry
* Electrical panels and cabinets
* Wiring and cable management
* Protection systems
* Earthing and grounding
* Thermal considerations
* Electrical-mechanical interfaces
* Ensure electrical design requirements are effectively translated into mechanical packaging and enclosure requirements.
* Facilitate resolution of electrical-mechanical integration issues during development and industrialization.

**D. Design Validation & Engineering Quality**

* Establish robust **Design Verification and Validation (DVP&R)** processes.
* Drive engineering risk assessment through **DFMEA** and structured design reviews.
* Ensure design issues identified during prototype, testing or production are addressed through systematic root-cause analysis.
* Drive engineering change management through controlled **ECR/ECN** processes.
* Strengthen lessons-learned processes to prevent recurrence of design failures.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of drawings, specifications, BOMs and technical documentation.

**E. Value Engineering & Cost Optimization**

* Lead **Value Engineering / VA-VE** initiatives across electrical and mechanical designs.
* Identify opportunities for:
* Material optimization
* Component standardization
* Part-count reduction
* Alternate material selection
* Design simplification
* Manufacturing process optimization
* Supplier localization
* Partner with Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams to identify technically viable cost-reduction opportunities.
* Ensure cost improvements do not compromise product safety, reliability or functional performance.

**F. New Product Development & Industrialization**

* Lead engineering involvement from concept through production release.
* Support prototype development, testing, pilot builds and manufacturing readiness.
* Ensure timely release of:
* 3D models
* 2D manufacturing drawings
* Electrical drawings/schematics
* BOMs
* Technical specifications
* Design validation requirements
* Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering to achieve smooth transition from design to production.
* Review manufacturability risks before production release.

**G. Cross-Functional Leadership**

Work closely with:

* Manufacturing / Production
* Quality
* SCM & Procurement
* Methods / Industrialization
* Maintenance
* Project Management
* Sales / Application Engineering
* Suppliers and technology partners

Drive structured resolution of engineering issues with clear accountability and timelines.

**H. Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams across mechanical and electrical engineering.
* Build technical depth and succession capability within the design organization.
* Define engineering competency and skill matrices.
* Identify capability gaps and implement appropriate technical development plans.
* Develop technical leads and future engineering managers.
* Establish a strong culture of **design ownership, technical rigor, innovation and continuous improvement**.
* Review team capacity against current and future project requirements.

**4. Essential Candidate Profile**

The candidate **must have**:

* **18+ years of overall engineering/design experience.**
* Engineering degree in **Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics or a closely related engineering discipline**.
* Strong practical exposure to **both electrical engineering and mechanical design**.
* **Strong sheet metal design experience. This is an essential selection criterion.**
* Experience leading engineering/design teams.
* Experience managing design from concept through manufacturing release.
* Strong understanding of **DFM, DFA, DFMEA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, BOM management and engineering change control**.
* Experience working closely with manufacturing, quality and supply-chain functions.
* Strong understanding of cost optimization and value engineering.
* Ability to conduct and challenge technical design reviews across multiple engineering disciplines.

**Specific product-line experience is not mandatory.** Candidates from different industrial/product backgrounds can be considered provided they demonstrate strong electrical-mechanical design capability and substantial sheet metal engineering experience.

**5. Preferred Technical Competencies**

* 3D mechanical design and CAD
* Sheet metal modelling
* Electrical design/schematic understanding
* GD&T
* Tolerance stack-up analysis
* DFMEA
* DFM/DFA
* DVP&R
* VA/VE
* ECR/ECN
* BOM management
* Material selection
* Manufacturing process knowledge
* Root Cause Analysis / 8D

jobs.title: Risk Modelling Validation & Insights Specialist
jobs.company: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ)
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

As a Manager, Modelling Insights is responsible for leading model monitoring and portfolio performance assessment across ANZs credit risk model inventory. The role combines deep analytical expertise, portfolio risk knowledge, and strong stakeholder engagement to deliver actionable insights on model performance, emerging risks, and portfolio behaviour.

The successful candidate will leverage advanced analytics, data visualisation, and statistical techniques to assess model effectiveness, identify performance deterioration, evaluate key risk drivers, and support compliance with internal model risk management standards and regulatory expectations.

Banking is changing and we re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru  
Work Hours: Morning Shift**

### What will your day look like

As a Risk Modelling Validation & Insights Specialist, you are expected to undertake the following activities that are deemed core to the role:

* Lead model monitoring and performance analysis across credit risk models, including Decision, Basel Capital, IF/Provisioning, and other risk models
* Drive deep-dive investigations into model outcomes, portfolio performance, segmentation strategies, business growth initiatives, and risk appetite changes
* Develop and enhance interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks, and management reporting to provide timely risk and performance insights
* Identify opportunities to improve monitoring methodologies, data quality, automation, and analytics capabilities through innovative use of data science and AI/ML techniques
* Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to team members, fostering a high-performing and continuously improving analytical team
* Partner with model developers, validators, portfolio managers, risk teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure effective governance and risk insight generation

### What will you bring

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

* Strong experience in model monitoring, model validation, credit risk analytics, or model risk management within financial services
* Demonstrated knowledge of Decision Models, Basel Capital Models, IF/Provisioning Models, and associated regulatory expectations
* Proficiency in Python, SAS, R, SQL, and large-scale data analysis
* Solid understanding of Machine Learning (ML) techniques and emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in risk management, with practical experience preferred
* Strong understanding of credit risk portfolios and banking products, including mortgages, personal lending, credit cards, unsecured lending, SME, commercial, and institutional products
* Experience assessing model performance metrics, stability measures, calibration, discrimination, segmentation, and monitoring frameworks
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into business insights and recommendations
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop teams within a collaborative and diverse environment

You re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we d love to hear from you.

The Primary Resource Person will be responsible for developing, reviewing, and implementing a structured, child-centric, and competency-based curriculum for Grades 15 across the school network.

The role involves academic content development, lesson planning, teacher training, assessment design, and monitoring classroom implementation to ensure consistent academic standards across branches.

The candidate should possess strong subject knowledge, pedagogical expertise, and the ability to translate curriculum objectives into effective teaching-learning practices aligned with CBSE guidelines, NEP 2020, and the National Curriculum Framework (NCF).

* Develop and review centralized curriculum frameworks, annual academic plans, and subject-wise syllabi for Grades 15.
* Design structured lesson plans, teaching-learning materials, worksheets, activity modules, and classroom resources.
* Ensure curriculum alignment with CBSE guidelines, NEP 2020, NCF, and competency-based learning objectives.

**B. Content Development & Academic Resources**

* Develop and review textbooks, workbooks, teacher handbooks, lesson presentations, and supplementary learning materials.

* Demonstrate effective classroom practices and provide guidance on lesson delivery, classroom engagement, and student assessment.
* Support teachers in implementing curriculum objectives effectively.

**D. Assessment & Learning Outcomes**

* Design competency-based assessments, worksheets, question banks, and periodic evaluation tools.
* Develop assessment rubrics and learning outcome frameworks for Grades 15.
* Analyse student performance data and identify learning gaps.
* Recommend remedial strategies and enrichment activities to improve student achievement.
* Promote continuous and comprehensive assessment practices appropriate to the primary level.

**E. Research, Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Research emerging pedagogical practices, educational trends, and innovative teaching methodologies.
* Incorporate best practices in primary education into curriculum development and teacher training.
* Collect feedback from Zonal Coordinators, R&D Heads, teachers and Principals to improve academic resources.

**4. Experience**

* Minimum **5–8 years of relevant experience** in primary teaching, academic coordination, curriculum development, or teacher training.
* Prior experience as a Primary Teacher, Academic Coordinator, Subject Coordinator, Curriculum Developer or Resource Person is preferred.
* Experience in CBSE schools and multi-branch academic implementation will be an added advantage.
* Experience in developing lesson plans, academic content, assessment materials, and conducting teacher training programmes is desirable.
* Prior experience as a content developer with publications is preferred.

**5. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of primary-level pedagogy and child development.

* Expertise in competency-based education, experiential learning, and activity-based teaching.

jobs.title: Manager - Product Management
jobs.location: Bengaluru, Hubballi, Mangaluru, Mysuru, Belagavi, India
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

To drive sustainable and profitable growth of the assigned product portfolio through market-led portfolio strategy, customer

insight, product development, lifecycle management, pricing, go-to-market execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

The role is responsible for identifying market opportunities and portfolio gaps, developing differentiated customer value

propositions, building product roadmaps, managing new product development and launches, improving portfolio

profitability, and ensuring products remain competitive and relevant throughout their lifecycle.

Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Legal, Service, and

other relevant stakeholders to translate customer and business requirements into commercially successful products and

solutions.

  

3. Key Business Dimensions

- Revenue, volume, growth, market share, and profitability of the assigned portfolio.

- Number of categories, subcategories, products, variants, and SKUs managed.

- New Product Development pipeline, annual launch plan, cycle time, and launch performance.

- Revenue and margin contribution from new, strategic, differentiated, or premium products.

- Pricing, realisation, product mix, cost optimisation, and value-engineering impact.

- Geographic, channel, customer, distributor, dealer, retailer, and influencer coverage, as applicable.

- Product availability, inventory health, service levels, quality, complaints, and customer adoption.

- Product development, research, communication, training, and market-development budgets.

- Portfolio rationalisation, SKU productivity, and product master-data accuracy.

  

4. Key Result Areas and Accountabilities

A. Product and Portfolio Strategy

- Develop and execute the strategic plan for the assigned portfolio in alignment with business objectives.

- Define the role of each category, product family, product, and SKU within the portfolio.

- Identify growth opportunities across segments, applications, channels, price points, and geographies.

- Develop short- and long-term product roadmaps based on market potential, customer needs, technology trends, and business

priorities.

- Conduct portfolio gap analysis and recommend new products, variants, specifications, pack sizes, solutions, or services.

- Prioritise initiatives based on market attractiveness, competitive strength, profitability, strategic fit, and organisational

capability.

- Drive portfolio mix improvement and support annual operating, category, and long-range plans.

  

B. Market, Industry and Competitive Intelligence

- Monitor macroeconomic, regulatory, technology, customer, channel, and industry trends affecting the portfolio.

- Track market size, growth, segmentation, applications, price bands, channel dynamics, and competitive intensity.

- Build structured market-intelligence mechanisms through field inputs, research, channel partners, customers, exhibitions, and

secondary sources.

- Benchmark competitor range, specifications, features, quality, pricing, positioning, distribution, communication, service, and

launches.

- Convert market and competitive intelligence into implications for portfolio, pricing, development, and go-to-market decisions.

- Maintain competitive comparison tools and identify emerging categories, substitutes, adjacent opportunities, and disruptive

technologies.

  

C. Customer and Consumer Insights

- Develop a deep understanding of customer, consumer, channel, influencer, installer, applicator, and end-user needs, as

applicable.

- Create customer personas and segment customers by needs, applications, behaviour, value expectations, and purchase

drivers.

- Map customer journeys, pain points, barriers, expectations, interaction points, and moments of truth.

- Gather Voice of Customer through visits, interviews, focus groups, surveys, complaint analysis, feedback, and usage

observation.

- Plan qualitative and quantitative research and translate insights into requirements, propositions, experience improvements,

and communication priorities.

- Validate concepts, prototypes, features, packaging, pricing, and communication before commercial launch.

  

D. Product Roadmap and New Product Development

- Develop and maintain a prioritised product roadmap aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, strategy, and

technical feasibility.

- Define product concepts, applications, target segments, technical requirements, expected benefits, target price, volume

potential, and commercial expectations.

- Create product briefs and Product Requirement Documents with relevant stakeholders.

- Lead cross-functional development projects from concept through commercialisation using a defined stage-gate process.

- Track milestones, risks, dependencies, costs, trials, validations, certifications, and launch readiness.

- Facilitate prototype evaluation, technical validation, customer trials, pilots, and market testing.

- Conduct post-launch reviews and maintain a balanced innovation pipeline.

  

E. Product Lifecycle and SKU Management

- Manage products across introduction, growth, maturity, and decline stages.

- Define lifecycle-specific pricing, positioning, distribution, communication, promotion, and investment strategies.

- Review product and SKU performance using revenue, volume, growth, margin, availability, inventory, and strategic relevance.

- Identify slow-moving, obsolete, duplicate, low-margin, or low-potential SKUs and lead rationalisation, replacement, migration,

or phase-out plans.

- Ensure smooth transition from legacy products and maintain accurate portfolio, lifecycle, and product-master information.

- Recommend upgrades, extensions, repositioning, cost optimisation, or withdrawal based on performance.

  

F. Business Case and Commercial Viability

- Prepare business cases for new products, upgrades, localisation, capacity, portfolio extensions, and strategic investments.

- Estimate addressable opportunity, volume, revenue, price, margin, investment, payback, and key assumptions.

- Evaluate scenario sensitivity to price, volume, cost, investment, and market adoption.

- Assess technical feasibility, operational readiness, supply-chain implications, and commercial risks.

- Conduct post-launch reviews against approved assumptions and recommend acceleration, correction, continuation, or

closure.

  

G. Pricing and Profitability Management

- Develop pricing recommendations based on customer value, competitive benchmarks, cost, positioning, willingness to pay,

and business objectives.

- Track market prices, competitor movements, discounts, schemes, channel margins, and price architecture.

- Evaluate premium, penetration, competitive, cost-plus, value-based, bundle, and promotional pricing approaches.

- Assess price-change impact on volume, revenue, margin, mix, and competitiveness and conduct price-volume-mix analysis.

- Identify opportunities for price correction, premiumisation, cost reduction, and margin improvement.

- Coordinate approved price changes and maintain product pricing and profitability dashboards.

  

H. Value Engineering and Cost Optimisation

- Build a pipeline of value-engineering and cost-optimisation opportunities without compromising customer value, quality,

safety, or performance.

- Evaluate alternative materials, specifications, processes, designs, vendors, and packaging with cross-functional teams.

- Prioritise opportunities based on savings, complexity, customer impact, and technical risk.

- Ensure robust testing, validation, approvals, and change management and track realised savings.

  

I. Customer Value Proposition and Positioning

- Develop differentiated value propositions defining the target customer, problem, benefits, reasons to believe, and

differentiation from alternatives.

- Quantify customer value through performance, productivity, convenience, durability, safety, savings,

jobs.title: Principal Scientist - Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Position Overview**
A dedicated Molecular Biology and Protein Biochemistry scientist is required to establish and grow Bangalore’s in-house capabilities in cell-based assays and protein analysis. The role will support current Biochemistry R&D projects and help develop workflows for future projects and product opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong experimental execution and troubleshooting skills with an innovative, business-oriented mindset. In addition to building robust laboratory workflows, the scientist will identify opportunities for new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions, explore market needs, investigate underperforming portfolio areas, and engage with customers and potential collaborators.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Establish and support in-house molecular biology, cell-based assay, and protein analysis capabilities within Bangalore Biochemistry R&D. Execute and troubleshoot workflows involving mammalian cell culture, protein extraction, GST-based assay support, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, protein quantification, chemiluminescent detection, and application or product validation.
  
  
In partnership with cross-functional and global teams, translate scientific and customer needs into new project proposals, product and catalogue opportunities, and practical application data. Contribute to market and portfolio assessments, including investigation of low-selling products and recommendations for improvement, repositioning, or future development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish, execute, and continuously improve molecular biology and protein biochemistry workflows for Biochemistry R&D projects.
* Perform mammalian cell-based experiments, including cell handling, treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Extract proteins using appropriate lysis buffers, protease and phosphatase inhibitors, and sample-stabilization conditions.
* Perform BCA or equivalent protein quantification assays and normalize samples for downstream analysis.
* Execute SDS-PAGE, protein transfer to PVDF membranes, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody incubation, washing, and chemiluminescent detection.
* Support GST-based experimental workflows, including protein–probe interaction studies, control planning, and data interpretation.
* Optimize and troubleshoot protein-analysis workflows, addressing weak signal, high background, poor transfer, protein degradation, and inconsistent sample loading.
* Maintain accurate experimental records, raw data, image files, calculations, and technical reports.
* Draft and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation for cell biology and protein-analysis workflows.
* Propose new biochemistry projects and catalogue additions based on scientific developments, customer needs, application opportunities, and market research.
* Conduct or coordinate market and portfolio assessments; investigate low-selling products to understand potential technical, application, positioning, or customer-related factors and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Engage with customers to understand their workflows and challenges, discuss application needs, and support technical data generation and product validation.
* Identify and develop potential collaborations with internal teams, external researchers, customers, or other relevant partners.
* Support product and application validation, proof-of-concept studies, customer-facing technical data generation, and internal capability development.
* Coordinate with global R&D, application, product management, quality, EHS, and manufacturing teams as needed.
* Manage critical reagents, including antibodies, buffers, gels, membranes, protein ladders, cell-culture consumables, and assay reagents.
* Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, biological sample handling, chemical hygiene, and documentation requirements.
* Travel as required to support customer engagement, collaboration, project work, or business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Cell Biology, or a related discipline.
* Preferably 6-10 years of relevant experience in industry or application-driven R&D.

**Required Technical Skills And Experience**

* Mammalian cell culture and cell-based assays, including treatment planning, harvesting, and lysate preparation.
* Protein extraction, sample stabilization, and BCA, Bradford, or equivalent protein quantification.
* SDS-PAGE, PVDF or nitrocellulose transfer, Ponceau staining, Western blotting, antibody optimization, and chemiluminescent imaging.
* Experimental design using appropriate positive, negative, no-light, no-treatment, and competitor controls.
* Strong knowledge of protein chemistry, molecular biology, and biochemical assay principles.
* Troubleshooting protein degradation, weak signal, non-specific bands, high background, uneven transfer, and loading variation.
* Preferred: probe-based assays or photo-affinity labelling; GST workflows; recombinant protein expression and purification; LC-MS, HPLC, or other orthogonal characterization; product or application development; GLP-like documentation and R&D quality systems.

**Behavioural and functional competencies**

* Innovative mindset with the ability to spot scientific, application, and business opportunities.
* Strong experimental planning and troubleshooting mindset, with the ability to guide and train scientific and technical staff and contribute to project planning.
* Good documentation discipline and awareness of data integrity.
* Ability to work independently in a newly developing capability area.
* Cross-functional communication with chemistry, biology, application, product, and commercial teams.
* Scientific curiosity and the ability to translate protocols into robust, reproducible workflows.
* Customer-oriented approach and openness to engaging with customers and collaborators.
* Ability to assess market feedback and portfolio performance and turn findings into actionable proposals.
* Safety-conscious laboratory working style.
* Ability to train junior scientists or technical staff as the capability expands.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

**ABOUT US**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond-based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**JOB IN SUMMARY**

The Regional Food Safety Microbiologist for Asia Pacific will provide advanced scientific leadership and technical expertise in food microbiology, microbiological risk management, environmental monitoring, validation science and food safety systems.

The role will support the implementation of global food safety strategies and initiatives across Asia Pacific while ensuring effective deployment of microbiological control programs, environmental monitoring systems, validation programs and risk management practices. The position will support ofi's Zero Incident Mindset through the application of sound science, robust risk assessments and continuous improvement of food safety controls.

As part of the Global Food Safety COE, the role will work closely with regional Quality & Food Safety teams, site leadership, Operations, Engineering and global food safety experts to drive harmonization, capability building and consistent application of food safety standards across all product platforms.

* Support continuous improvement of global food safety standards and governance processes.

* Support the development of preventive food safety controls using scientific and risk-based approaches.

**Environmental Monitoring Programs**

* Lead deployment and continuous improvement of environmental monitoring programs across Asia Pacific.

* Drive standardization of environmental monitoring methodologies across the region.

**Validation & Verification**

* Provide technical leadership for food safety validation and verification programs.

* Ensure effective documentation and governance of validation programs.

* Support root cause investigations and development of corrective and preventive actions.
* Review regional microbiological trends and identify recurring issues requiring systematic improvement.
* Provide guidance during product disposition decisions and crisis management activities.

**Job Title:**
Product Owner - Finance AI
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**About Unilever**
Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
  
  
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.
  
  
**Role Purpose**

* Lead the design, delivery and adoption of AI solutions (GenAI, agentic AI and intelligent automation) across Finance processes.
* Turn Finance problems into AI use cases that can be audited and scaled, and that deliver measurable value.
* Make sure solutions meet clean-core, SOX and data governance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Finance AI Use-Case Ownership
* Find and prioritise AI and automation opportunities across R2R, P2P, O2C, Treasury and FP&A .
* Build business cases with baseline KPIs: cycle time, manual effort, error rate and cost savings.
* Own the use-case backlog and roadmap, from proof of concept through MVP to scaled rollout.
* Solution Design & Delivery
* Work with Enterprise Architecture, HAP and vendor teams on how agents are designed: orchestration, context memory, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and confidence scoring.
* Define integration patterns between AI platforms (e.g., GCP Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio) and SAP S/4HANA or ECC .
* Write functional specs, prompt and rule logic, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Run delivery across the stage gates: Initiate → Plan → Build → Test → Deploy → Stabilise.
* Governance, Controls & Responsible AI
* Make sure AI outputs are explainable, traceable and ready for audit (logs, evidence, sign-offs, version history).
* Uphold SoD, access controls, data privacy and Responsible AI policies.
* Define how model performance and drift are monitored, plus exception handling and rollback.
* Vendor & Cost Management
* Challenge vendor estimates, separating reusable from use-case-specific components.
* Track budget, burn rate and SLAs, and measure benefits against the business case.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Adoption
* Work with Finance process owners, Controllership, Treasury, IT, Data and Audit teams.
* Present steerco updates, demos and value stories to senior leadership.
* Lead change management, user training and AI upskilling in Finance teams.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Can explain AI in Finance terms and Finance in AI terms.
* Delivery-focused and data-led, measuring outcomes rather than activity.
* Influences without authority across Finance, IT and vendors.
* Practical about innovation: tries standard features and the platform first, and builds custom only when needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance or IT. CA/CMA/MBA (Finance) is a plus.
* AI certification preferred

**Success Measures**

* At least 2–3 Finance AI use cases live in production, with signed-off benefits.
* Measurable cut in manual effort and cycle time against baseline.
* No audit findings on deployed AI solutions.
* Higher adoption and AI skills across the Finance teams supported.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

jobs.description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
This is a Consulting role for 3 - 6 months
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills:**
**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React
* Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms
* Experience consuming and querying OpenSearch for fast, flexible reporting and fuzzy filtering

**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

New Product Development (NPD)

ABOUT KIMIRICA

Kimirica is a luxury D2C brand specialising in
**Bath & Body, Skincare, Fine Fragrances, Home Fragrance, Wellness and Gifting**

ROLE SUMMARY

**Bath & Body, Skincare, Fine Fragrances, Home Fragrance, Wellness and Gifting**

HOW TO APPLY

Are you passionate about innovation and building differentiated products in the beauty, fragrance and personal care space? Join Kimirica and help shape the next generation of premium lifestyle products.

jobs.description:
Product Innovation Lead

**Location:**
Gurugram / Faridabad

**Experience:**
5–8+ years

**Function:**
Product Innovation & R&D

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Days:**
5 days a week

**Reporting To:**
Founder / CEO

About Rasayanam

Rasayanam is a new-age nutrition and supplements brand built for people who want everyday progress without shortcuts.

We believe supplements should deliver meaningful results, be safe to use consistently, and earn trust through evidence rather than marketing claims. We focus on purposeful formulations, clinically supported ingredients and doses, transparent communication, and products designed for long-term use.

We are building for the Conscious Indian Improver - someone who wants results, asks questions, understands what they put into their body, and does not blindly trust brands.

This is also how we expect ourselves to work: high ownership, clear thinking, strong standards, and a bias toward doing what is right for the customer over what is easiest in the short term.

About the Role

At Rasayanam, we do not build products to follow trends—we build products customers can trust with their health. The Product Innovation Lead will own the end-to-end product journey, from identifying unmet customer needs to developing evidence-backed formulations ready for commercialization. Success in this role is measured not by launch volume, but by product quality, measurable customer outcomes, and the long-term trust our formulations earn.

What You’ll Own

* **End-to-End Product Innovation:**
  Identify meaningful customer health needs, manage the innovation pipeline, and lead formulation development from concept to commercial launch.
* **Scientific Research & Formulation Design:**
  Evaluate scientific literature and emerging ingredients to create safe, effective formulations with clearly defined usage protocols and evidence standards.
* **Safety, Quality & Regulatory Compliance:**
  Own testing, validation, certifications, and quality benchmarks while ensuring every product claim is scientifically defensible.
* **Customer Outcome Measurement:**
  Define expected health outcomes for every product and continuously refine formulations using real customer feedback and performance data.
* **Supplier & Manufacturing Qualification:**
  Evaluate and onboard ingredient suppliers and manufacturing partners to maintain high standards of traceability, transparency, and quality across the supply chain.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:**
  Partner closely with Marketing, CX, Operations, and Quality teams to build repeatable systems that strengthen product decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

**Must Have**

* 5–8+ years of professional experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, functional foods, pharmaceuticals, or related health and wellness categories.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience specifically in product development, formulation, or innovation roles.
* Strong ability to critically analyze scientific literature and translate clinical research into practical, safe product decisions.
* Direct experience managing regulatory compliance (e.g., FSSAI), certifications, quality standards, and third-party testing protocols.
* High ownership mindset with sharp analytical judgment, rigorous attention to detail, and an uncompromising commitment to long-term safety over short-term speed.

**Good to Have**

* Experience scaling D2C or consumer-first nutrition brands in the Indian market.
* Familiarity with clinical trial design or claim substantiation documentation.
* Strong existing network of vetted raw-ingredient suppliers and GMP-certified manufacturing partners.

How You’ll Work

We’re looking for people who:

* **Own outcomes, not just tasks.**
  You take responsibility from problem to resolution.
* **Move with urgency.**
  You act decisively without lowering the bar.
* **Think for yourself.**
  You bring a point of view, challenge assumptions, and use judgment.
* **Put the customer first.**
  You optimize for what is genuinely right for the customer, not what is easiest or most convenient.
* **Raise the bar.**
  You are never satisfied with “good enough” when better is possible.

Why Rasayanam

We’re building a brand that aims to make wellness more trustworthy, transparent, and genuinely useful for Indian consumers. At Rasayanam, you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with a growing team, take meaningful ownership, and help build something from the ground up.

**Job Title:**
Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Company:**
MARS Cosmetics

**About MARS Cosmetics:**

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

**Role Summary**

Own end-to-end skincare and haircare product development from concept to launch, driving formulation, packaging, claims, costing, timelines, and cross-functional execution with internal teams and 3P manufacturers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead the NPD pipeline across skincare (serums, gels, emulsions) and haircare (shampoos, conditioners, masks, oils, scalp treatments, styling): identify opportunities, build briefs, define hero claims/USPs, and execute launch plans.
2. Manage formulation development with 3P labs/OEMs, from prototypes and performance benchmarks through stability, finalization, and scale-up.
3. Translate consumer problems into measurable product targets (e.g., hydration, brightening, anti-hairfall, anti-dandruff, frizz control, scalp oil control).
4. Drive packaging development: component selection (pumps, droppers, flip-tops), compatibility and leakage/transport testing, artwork readiness, and vendor coordination.
5. Own product quality and performance: sensorial targets (texture, foam, slip, rinse feel), fragrance direction, efficacy and claims substantiation inputs, safety, and QA handover.
6. Build and control timelines using stage-gates; manage risks, iterations, and stakeholder alignment.
7. Own product costing (COGS/BOM): target pricing, value engineering, MOQ planning, and margin guardrails.
8. Coordinate regulatory readiness for India, including labeling/claims compliance and documentation with RA/QA partners.
9. Benchmark competitors and global trends (actives, delivery systems, textures, formats) and convert them into actionable specs.

**Requirements**

1. 4–8 years in skincare and/or haircare NPD (brand side or OEM/ODM), with multiple launches shipped.
2. Strong formulation and packaging understanding: emulsions/gels/serums for skincare; surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones, and oils for haircare; compatibility and stability basics.
3. Experience running vendor cycles with Indian/China/SEA partners, including iteration discipline, negotiation, and scale-up execution.
4. Strong project management; comfortable with BOM, COGS, MOQ, margin targets, and launch scorecards.
5. High ownership, fast execution, and strong cross-functional communication.

jobs.title: AGM - Quality Control
jobs.description:
Job Title: Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Quality Control (QC)  
Department: Quality Control  
Industry: Pharmaceuticals – API / Bulk Drug Manufacturing  
Reports To: Head of Quality / Site Quality Head / VP – Quality  
Job Purpose:  
To lead and manage overall Quality Control laboratory operations—covering raw material, in-process, intermediate, finished API, and stability testing—while ensuring 100% compliance with cGMP, GLP, Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and global regulatory standards (USFDA, EDQM, WHO, CDSCO).  
Key Responsibilities:

* Laboratory Operations: Direct end-to-end sampling, analytical testing, and timely release of Raw Materials (RM), Packing Materials (PM), In-Process samples, Intermediates, Finished APIs, and Water/Environment monitoring samples to meet production and dispatch schedules.
* Instrumentation & Calibration: Ensure timely qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration, and preventive maintenance of analytical instruments including HPLC, GC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, ICP-OES, XRD, FTIR, UV, and Karl Fischer.
* Stability Management: Oversee the stability program (charging, pulling, testing, and trend evaluation) in accordance with ICH guidelines and regulatory filing commitments.
* Regulatory Audits & Compliance: Serve as the primary auditee for QC during regulatory inspections (USFDA, MHRA, EU-GMP, TGA, PMDA, WHO) and customer audits, ensuring continuous audit readiness.
* Data Integrity & Computerized Systems: Enforce strict compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles across all standalone instruments, CDS (Empower/Chromeleon), and LIMS; oversee periodic audit trail reviews.
* QMS & Investigations: Lead root-cause investigations for Out-of-Specification (OOS), Out-of-Trend (OOT), and laboratory incidents; review and approve Deviations, Change Controls, and CAPAs.
* Method Transfer & Validation: Oversee Analytical Method Validation (AMV), Method Verification, and Analytical Method Transfer (AMT) from R&D/ADL to commercial QC.
* Documentation Control: Review and approve QC SOPs, Specifications, Standard Testing Procedures (STPs), and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs).
* Standards & Inventory Management: Manage qualification, storage, and inventory of reference/working standards, impurities, columns, and reagents.
* Team Leadership & Budgeting: Lead, mentor, and manage shift schedules for QC Managers and Analysts; prepare annual Capex/Opex budgets and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.

Qualifications & Experience:

* Education: M.Sc. (Chemistry / Analytical Chemistry / Organic Chemistry) or M.Pharm.
* Experience: 15–20+ years in Pharmaceutical Quality Control, with extensive experience in API / Bulk Drug manufacturing and at least 4–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Regulatory Exposure: Proven track record of successfully handling stringent regulatory audits (USFDA, EDQM, EU-GMP, etc.).

Key Skills & Competencies:

* Expertise in chromatography (HPLC, GC), spectroscopy, and trace-level impurity analysis (nitrosamines, genotoxic impurities, elemental impurities).
* Thorough knowledge of ICH guidelines (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q7) and major pharmacopeias (USP, EP, BP, IP).
* Strong analytical troubleshooting, crisis management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Pay: ₹1,100,000.00 - ₹1,900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your total years of experience ?
* What is your relevant years of experience in API ?
* What is your current CTC ?
* What is your expected CTC ?
* Mention your notice period
* Where is your current location

Work Location: In person

SELCO Foundation is a not-for-profit organization engaged in field-based research and development (R&D) and ecosystem building to promote decentralized renewable energy solutions that alleviate poverty across urban, rural, and tribal communities. The Foundation works across multiple sectors including energy access, the built environment, healthcare, skill development, entrepreneurship, and sustainable livelihoods. Our mission is to design and implement socially, financially, and environmentally inclusive solutions through access to sustainable energy.
  
  
Within the Agriculture and Allied Livelihoods vertical, SELCO Foundation develops sustainable energy-driven solutions across agriculture, animal husbandry, and allied sectors. We work with diverse value chains including cereals, millets, oilseeds, spices, dairy, poultry, horticulture, and post-harvest systems to improve productivity, diversify farm incomes, reduce drudgery, and strengthen climate resilience. Our work focuses on enabling smallholder farmers, FPOs/FPCs, SHGs, entrepreneurs, and ecosystem stakeholders through innovative technologies, research, and capacity building.
  
  
The Livelihood scaling Intern will contribute to research, documentation, scaling solutions, stakeholder engagement, and knowledge management to support the scaling and amplify solution of sustainable agriculture.
  
  
You can find more information about SELCO Foundation and our work on our Organization Website.

### **Position Details**

**Designation:** Intern- Livelihood Scaling (6 Months)
  
**Reporting To:**Senior Program Manager – Livelihood Scaling, Central Office, Bengaluru
  
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months
  
**Location:** Headquarters, Bengaluru
  
**Travel:** Extensive field travel across project locations as required (10–15 days/month)
  
**Work Type:** Field and Office-based
  
**Working Days:** Monday to Friday (9:30 AM – 5:30 PM)
  
**Languages Preferred:** English, Kannada, Hindi (additional regional languages are an advantage)
  
**Interview Process:** Initial telephonic/Google Meet interaction followed by an in-person interview
  
**Start Date:** Immediately

### **About the Position**

The Livelihood Scaling Intern will support the Livelihood Scaling team in identifying, documenting, and promoting climate-smart and sustainable Livelihood Scaling. The Intern will work closely with farmers, FPOs, startups, research institutions, government departments, and ecosystem partners to conduct research, data compiling, digitalization, reports, develop case studies, and generate actionable insights for program design and implementation. The Internship duration will be 6 months.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct primary and secondary research on agriculture, climate-smart agriculture, renewable energy, mechanization, value chains, and rural livelihoods.
* Undertake field visits to identify and document innovative and scale farming practices, technologies, and business models.
* Develop high-quality case studies, success stories, impact stories, technical documentation, and research reports.
* Conduct stakeholder meetings and interviews with farmers, FPOs, startups, government departments, research institutions, NGOs, and private sector partners.
* Map emerging scale agricultural technologies, innovations, government schemes, policies, and market trends.
* Support baseline surveys, field assessments, validation studies, and data collection activities.
* Prepare concept notes, presentations, policy briefs, reports, and other knowledge products.
* Maintain and regularly update all project documentation, databases, case study repositories, and knowledge management systems.
* Support the organization of workshops, consultations, exposure visits, innovation showcases, and capacity-building programs.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure timely documentation and dissemination of project learnings.
* Assist in proposal development, pilot design, monitoring, evaluation, and knowledge management activities.

### **Desired Profile**

* Bachelor's/master's in agriculture, Agricultural Engineering, Horticulture, Forestry, Food Science, Rural Development, or allied disciplines.
* Strong interest in agricultural innovation, climate-smart agriculture, sustainable livelihoods, and rural development.
* Experience in research, documentation, case study development, stakeholder engagement, or the development sector is preferred.
* Excellent analytical, writing, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Canva for designing presentations, reports, infographics, and communication materials.
* Ability to maintain organized documentation and knowledge repositories.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field visits and stakeholder consultations.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

**Internship Duration:** 6 Months
  
**Location:** Bengaluru (Head Office) with travel to project locations across India as required.
  
**Travel Requirement:** Approximately 10–15 days per month.
