We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager - Product Development - Antenna to provide technical and product leadership for the development, integration, qualification, industrialization, and delivery of advanced Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) antenna systems for SATCOM applications.
  
  
The candidate will act as a technical authority for phased-array antenna products, leading multidisciplinary engineering activities across the complete product lifecycle, from requirements definition and architecture through design reviews, qualification, production readiness, and final product delivery
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership, direction, and mentoring to multidisciplinary engineering teams involved in AESA antenna development, integration, verification, and qualification.
* Act as the Product Design Authority for phased-array antenna requirements, system architecture, key design decisions, technical trade-offs, and engineering review gates.
* Own and maintain the antenna product technical requirements baseline and ensure traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Lead technical activities through entire product lifecycle.
* Coordinate RF, antenna, electronics, mechanical, thermal, embedded software, FPGA, modem, systems engineering, manufacturing, and test teams.
* Follow up with suppliers, technology partners, and subcontractors to track technical activities, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and program milestones.
* Conduct and participate in technical design reviews with suppliers and internal engineering teams.
* Serve as the primary technical/program interface for major antenna development initiatives.
* Provide regular technical and program updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders, including progress, risks, dependencies, mitigation actions, and recovery plans.
* Foster effective collaboration across geographically distributed engineering teams and technology partners.
* Drive continuous improvement, design maturity, engineering best practices, and lessons learned throughout the product lifecycle.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, RF/Microwave, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant engineering experience, including at least 5 years in technical, engineering, or product leadership.
* Proven experience developing phased-array/AESA antennas and SATCOM products, preferably in Ka-band and/or Ku-band.
* Strong understanding of phased-array architectures, RF front ends, beamforming, antenna elements, calibration, and RF system design.
* Good knowledge of key antenna performance parameters, including EIRP, G/T, gain, polarization, scan loss, sidelobes, beamwidth, and cross-polarization.
* Good understanding of RF/microwave components, including PA, LNA, phase shifters, filters, MMICs, and beamforming ICs.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete development lifecycle, including SRR, PDR, CDR, qualification, acceptance, and product release.
* Experience with antenna integration, OTA/RF testing, anechoic chambers, and RF test equipment.
* Familiarity with antenna and RF simulation tools such as HFSS, CST, ADS, AWR, MATLAB, or equivalent.
* Experience with environmental qualification process as applicable.
* Experience working with suppliers and technology partners, including technical evaluations, RFI/RFP/RFQ reviews, compliance assessments, and technical negotiations.
* Ability to translate complex technical requirements and dependencies into clear and executable product development plans.
* Strong technical leadership, engineering judgment, system-level problem solving, and risk management skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional and geographically distributed teams in demanding development, integration, and qualification environments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including customer, partner, and executive-level interactions.
* Strong focus on product quality, design maturity, manufacturability, continuous improvement, and technology evolution.

jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.
  
  
If you are passionate about culinary excellence, logistics, and delivering world-class service, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.
  
  
As a
**Manager Culinary Development,**
you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.
  
  
Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.
* Accountable for the product development life cycle management of EK owned, category specific, food and beverage items.
* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.
* Responsible for identifying and developing food and beverage promotional and celebratory initiatives to effectively promote and market EKs award winning offering.
* Responsible for carrying out regular industry benchmarking across all hospitality sectors to ensure that EK remains at the forefront of food and beverage innovation.

Qualification
  
  
**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**
**Qualification**

* An attested degree (12+3) or equivalent work experience.
* Culinary apprenticeship is preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation and standardisation of menus and recipes featuring North and South American cuisines, with in-depth knowledge of regional culinary traditions, authentic cooking techniques, emerging food trends, ingredient selection, nutritional principles, portion control and cost optimisation, ensuring culinary authenticity, consistency and alignment with diverse passenger preferences.

* And/or
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals, supported by sound knowledge of nutrition, dietary principles, menu engineering, allergen management and religious and cultural food requirements, ensuring nutritional suitability, recipe consistency and alignment with diverse passenger needs.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Comprehensive knowledge of and passion for, global cuisines, emerging culinary trends, and evolving guest preferences.
* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.
* Strong understanding of airline catering operations, including large-scale production, cook-chill processes, and the associated operational challenges and considerations.
* Proven ability to train, coach and educate colleagues and external catering partners on recipe execution and individual dish preparation.
* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised with strong planning, prioritisation, and project management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities within tight timeframes.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!
  
  
Salary & benefits
  
  
Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. That's in addition to transport benefits, life insurance and much more.
  
  
Discover what it's like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city of Dubai and build a rewarding career with Emirates!

jobs.title: Group Research & Innovation Manager
jobs.description:
**We’re Hiring: Group Research & Innovation Manager | Raibal Holding | Fujairah, UAE**

Raibal Holding is recruiting a permanent
**Group Research & Innovation Manager**
to run the Group’s research portfolio across a diversified farming platform, beginning with marine and agricultural research and extending across apiculture and livestock operations as the portfolio grows.

This is not a laboratory-based role. You will be the person who keeps the Group’s research organised, evidenced and moving: coordinating decisions on what to test, continue or stop, and making sure results reach the right destination, whether that is internal use on our farms, research services, commercial transfer or public benefit.

You will work alongside scientists, who retain authority over research methods, integrity and laboratory safety, and with Raibal’s business sponsors, who approve spending, contracts and formal acceptance.

**What you’ll do**

* **Control commitments:**
  oversee active research, agreements and deliverables, with a clear owner, due date and acceptance status for each
* **Maintain reliable evidence:**
  track sources, versions, results and gaps so every claim on priority work is backed by a source, test result or stated assumption
* **Plan capacity and cover:**
  coordinate people, facilities and specialist support, ensuring critical activities have named cover and documented dependencies
* **Prepare decisions:**
  run portfolio reviews, set priorities and bring complete proposals to decision or escalation promptly, with clear options, costs and uncertainties
* **Manage partners and adoption:**
  coordinate approved partnerships with universities, research institutes and technology providers, and ensure every pilot has a sponsor, baseline and measure before launch
* Report portfolio progress to senior management and route successful results into operational use

**What we’re looking for**

* Degree in science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience
* Proven leadership of at least two applied research or innovation programmes, including at least one with a measured pilot or adoption result
* Background in marine science, aquaculture, agriculture, food or environmental research is strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating research partners and operating teams to deliver measurable results
* Track record of making and escalating well-reasoned recommendations, with responsibility for budgets
* Excellent written English and clear, structured communication

**Why join Raibal Holding**

A rare opportunity to build and run a Group-wide research portfolio within one of the region’s growing agriculture and farming platforms, where your work translates directly into operational improvements across multiple businesses.

Application deadline:

**Full-Time**

**Location: Al Zorah Beach Resort, Ajman, United Arab Emirates**

**Department: Culinary**

**Management Level: Department Head**

**About Us**

Set within a rare natural paradise just a short drive from Dubai, Al Zorah Beach Resort is a sophisticated coastal retreat framed by protected mangroves, white sand beaches and vibrant lagoons.

As we undergo an exciting transformation guided by the highest global standards in luxury hospitality, this is a unique opportunity to be part of a journey that will culminate in the grand opening of Four Seasons Resort Ajman at Al Zorah in 2028.

From exceptional dining experiences to thoughtful moments of connection, our resort reflects understated elegance, personalised service and a genuine sense of place.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

A deep appreciation for culinary craftsmanship, authentic flavours and exceptional dining experiences is at the heart of this role.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in Arabic, Greek or Mediterranean cuisine, with the creativity and technical expertise to develop distinctive menus that celebrate quality ingredients, traditional techniques and contemporary presentation.

Beyond culinary expertise, you are an inspiring leader who takes pride in developing people, maintaining consistent standards and creating a kitchen environment built on respect, accountability and collaboration. You understand the commercial aspects of restaurant operations and have the confidence to translate a culinary vision into memorable guest experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the culinary operations of the assigned restaurant, ensuring exceptional food quality, consistency and presentation.
* Develop and execute menus inspired by Arabic, Greek or Mediterranean culinary traditions, reflecting the restaurant's concept and guest expectations.
* Create seasonal dishes and dining experiences that balance authenticity, creativity and contemporary presentation.
* Oversee daily kitchen operations, including preparation, production, service and quality control.
* Lead, coach and develop the culinary team, fostering a positive and professional working environment.
* Maintain consistency in recipes, cooking techniques, portion sizes and presentation standards.
* Collaborate with the Director of Culinary and Food & Beverage leadership on menu development and restaurant positioning.
* Manage food costs, inventory, purchasing requirements and waste reduction while maintaining product quality.
* Establish efficient kitchen procedures, production schedules and staffing arrangements.
* Ensure full compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene and allergen management requirements.
* Maintain strong relationships with suppliers to ensure ingredient quality, freshness and availability.
* Work closely with the restaurant service team to deliver a coordinated and personalised dining experience.
* Respond constructively to guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve culinary offerings.
* Support recruitment, performance management, training and succession development within the kitchen team.
* Contribute to culinary events, special promotions and dining initiatives that enhance the restaurant's reputation.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Proven experience as a Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chef or equivalent culinary leadership position within a luxury hotel, resort or established restaurant.
* Strong culinary expertise in at least one of the following cuisines: Arabic, Greek or Mediterranean.
* Demonstrated experience in menu creation, recipe development and culinary concept execution.
* Excellent knowledge of traditional and contemporary cooking techniques, ingredients and flavour combinations.
* Experience leading and developing multicultural culinary teams.
* Strong understanding of food cost management, inventory control, budgeting and kitchen productivity.
* Comprehensive knowledge of HACCP, food safety and hygiene standards.
* Ability to maintain exceptional quality and consistency in a demanding restaurant environment.
* Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.
* A genuine passion for hospitality, culinary innovation and developing future culinary talent.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and public holidays.

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape the culinary identity of a distinctive luxury beachfront resort.
* An exciting journey towards the opening of Four Seasons Resort Ajman at Al Zorah.
* Competitive tax-free salary and service charge.
* Medical insurance, annual leave, flight benefits and end-of-service gratuity.
* Complimentary accommodation, transportation and employee meals.
* Training, development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative culinary environment where creativity, leadership and craftsmanship are valued.

jobs.title: QC Manager
jobs.description:
QC Manager – Food Manufacturing

**Specialization: Sauces / Dairy Products**

**Location:** UAE  
**Industry:** Food Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 8–10 years in food manufacturing, including 3–5 years in a QC managerial role  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Microbiology, or a related field.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced QC Manager to lead our Quality Control and Quality Assurance functions within our food manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in sauces or dairy product manufacturing, with a proven ability to manage quality systems, food safety compliance, laboratory operations, and production quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage all QC and QA activities across production, processing, packaging, and storage.
* Ensure compliance with food safety standards, HACCP, GMP, ISO Food Cerifications, and applicable UAE food safety regulations.
* Establish, implement, and maintain quality management systems, SOPs, and food safety procedures.
* Monitor raw materials, in-process products, and finished goods to ensure compliance with approved specifications.
* Manage laboratory operations, product testing, sampling, and quality release procedures.
* Supervise quality inspections and ensure adherence to approved formulations, recipes, and manufacturing processes.
* Lead internal audits, external audits, customer inspections, and regulatory compliance activities.
* Investigate quality deviations, customer complaints, and non-conformities, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Oversee product traceability, shelf-life studies, product recalls, and food safety risk assessments.
* Lead, train, and develop the QC/QA team, including QC Inspectors and Laboratory Technicians.
* Coordinate with Production, R&D, Purchase, and Operations to ensure consistent product quality and continuous improvement.
* Prepare quality performance reports and monitor departmental KPIs.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in food manufacturing, with at least 3–5 years in a QC/QA leadership position.
* Mandatory experience in sauces or dairy product manufacturing.
* Strong technical knowledge of food safety, microbiology, laboratory testing, and quality management systems.
* Experience in HACCP, GMP, ISO certifications, and relevant food safety certification requirements.
* Knowledge of UAE food safety regulations and regulatory inspection requirements.
* Proven experience in managing quality teams and handling audits, customer complaints, and product quality issues.
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in a multi-product food manufacturing environment will be an advantage.

Product-Specific Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following product categories are encouraged to apply:

**Sauces:** Ketchup, mayonnaise, tomato paste, chili sauce, dressings, and other condiments.

**Dairy Products:** Milk, yogurt, flavored milk, cream, cheese, and other dairy products

How to Apply:

Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their updated CV to hr **@royalfi.com** with the subject line:

**QC Manager – Food Manufacturing**

Please mention your current location, expected salary, and availability in your application.

Only candidates with relevant food manufacturing experience in sauces or dairy products will be considered.

Pay: AED1.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Career Level Experienced Professional

Functions Research & Science

**Why Research and Development?**
---------------------------------

We are on a journey to A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World. A world where smokers who would otherwise continue to smoke, have migrated to smokeless alternatives. This is why we are always innovating, experimenting, and delivering new solutions. This is why our R&D and Science department is so important to the business, and we are investing and accelerating our activities to generate new science and innovation. Today, we operate in a broad spectrum of scientific fields including molecular biology, toxicology, and chemistry, and it is that breadth of expertise which fuels the relentless innovation and learning that sets us apart as an industry leader.

**Why BAT?**
------------

At BAT, we’re committed to more than just jobs, we’re dedicated to purposeful careers - It's one of the many reasons we have been named as a Global Top Employer for the eighth consecutive year.
  
  
We believe that Leadership shouldn’t be confined to titles. It’s a mindset and through our leading Learning and Development programmes, you’ll continuously develop your skills and experience. With our unwavering support, you’ll work in cross functional teams connecting with industry leaders and expanding your professional network.
  
  
Join us at BAT, where purpose meets possibility, and your career story unfolds.

**A Better Tomorrow**
---------------------

Building a Smokeless World is no small feat—it’s fueled by the collective efforts of talented individuals, each bringing their unique perspective. This is the most innovative chapter in BAT’s history, and you can help shape it.

Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

**Scientific Engagement Manager**
---------------------------------

**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.**  
**To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**

The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.

This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.

**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**

This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

**Role duties and accountabilities**
------------------------------------

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

jobs.title: Clinical Specialist – MEDLAB
jobs.description:
At
**AKI-MEDLAB**
, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to bring their authentic selves to work. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture that encourages personal expression, open communication, and meaningful professional relationships. We value and respect the unique qualities, perspectives, and expertise that each individual brings to our organization.

Our mission is to support, educate, and provide innovative solutions to clinical laboratories and healthcare professionals. Through technical expertise, professional education, and strong stakeholder partnerships, we strive to ensure the highest levels of customer satisfaction with the products and solutions we represent across the UAE.

Join us and become part of a team committed to excellence, continuous learning, and advancing laboratory diagnostics.

AKI-MEDLAB is seeking an experienced and highly motivated
**Clinical Specialist**
to strengthen our clinical and technical support capabilities across the United Arab Emirates. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing professional training programs, conducting on-site instrument validation, providing technical troubleshooting support, and delivering specialized training to clinical laboratories.

Working closely with Biomedical and the Commercial Team, the Clinical Specialist will translate strategic product priorities into practical clinical and technical solutions that address the evolving needs of the laboratory market.

Beyond individual instrument support, this role will champion a holistic, solution-oriented approach to laboratory diagnostics, positioning AKI-MEDLAB as a trusted technical and educational partner to clinical laboratories, healthcare professionals, and other key stakeholders.

The position will also play a key role in empowering the sales team with clinical expertise, product knowledge, and technical capabilities to strengthen customer engagement and drive sustainable business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Instrument Validation and Technical Support**

* Plan and implement on-site instrument validation services, including linearity, precision, accuracy, and cut-off verification, ensuring completion within agreed timelines.
* Act as the technical subject matter expert for the products and diagnostic solutions represented by AKI-MEDLAB across the UAE.
* Provide on-site and remote technical support for instrument installation, validation, performance evaluation, and troubleshooting.
* Deliver solution-oriented troubleshooting support for HPLC, ELISA, Multiplex, and other relevant laboratory methodologies.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer technical concerns while maintaining high standards of service quality.

**2. Clinical Education and Training**

* Develop annual education and training plans for clinical laboratories based on market requirements, customer needs, and emerging industry developments.
* Design and develop comprehensive training materials, including presentations, practical worksheets, training manuals, and pre- and post-training assessment tools.
* Organize and deliver on-site training programs for laboratory professionals, ensuring effective knowledge transfer and competency development.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and continuously improve educational programs based on customer feedback and assessment outcomes.
* Support internal sales teams through product education, technical training, and clinical knowledge development.

**3. Laboratory Accreditation and Quality Management**

* Support clinical laboratories in achieving and maintaining accreditation and compliance with CAP, JCI, and ISO 15189 requirements.
* Conduct laboratory gap assessments and provide guidance on documentation, implementation, staff training, and quality improvement initiatives.
* Assist laboratories in addressing and closing non-conformities (NCs) within agreed timelines.
* Provide technical guidance on proficiency testing, quality assurance, method verification, and validation requirements.
* Support laboratories in strengthening their quality management systems and maintaining regulatory and accreditation standards.

**4. Customer Relationship Management and Market Development**

* Conduct regular customer visits to understand laboratory requirements, identify technical challenges, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Identify new business opportunities through clinical engagement, technical consultations, and lead generation.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer visit reports, opportunities, and activity records in Salesforce (SFDC).
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with laboratory directors, pathologists, laboratory managers, quality managers, and other key stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Sales to develop customer-focused solution campaigns aligned with the Integrated Marketing Plan.
* Contribute to the development of AKI-MEDLAB's clinical reputation as a trusted provider of laboratory diagnostic solutions.

**Skills, Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in medical laboratory technology, Clinical Biochemistry, Medical Laboratory Science, or related discipline.
* A Master’s degree will be considered an advantage.
* 5–8 years of progressive experience in clinical laboratory operations, with demonstrated expertise in instrument validation, method verification, technical troubleshooting, and professional training.
* Proven experience in supporting laboratory accreditation, quality management systems, and proficiency testing.
* Strong knowledge of CAP, JCI, and ISO 15189 standards and their practical implementation within clinical laboratories.
* Experience working with modern laboratory diagnostic instruments and methodologies.
* Familiarity with the UAE healthcare and laboratory regulatory environment is essential; regional Middle East experience is highly desirable.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.

**Technical and Professional Competencies**

* Strong understanding of laboratory quality control, method validation, verification protocols, and biostatistical principles applied in clinical laboratories.
* Demonstrated ability to lead laboratory validation and accreditation initiatives and deliver results within established timelines.
* Excellent technical training, presentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical solutions for laboratory professionals.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a customer-focused and solution-oriented mindset.

**Leadership and Personal Attributes**

* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with the ability to guide laboratory teams through validation, quality improvement, and accreditation processes.
* Strong collaboration and lateral leadership skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams and international stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to establish trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently.
* Willingness to travel within the UAE and across regional markets as required.

**Why Join AKI-MEDLAB?**

At AKI-MEDLAB, you will have the opportunity to:

* Work with leading laboratory diagnostic technologies and innovative solutions.
* Make a meaningful contribution to improving laboratory quality and diagnostic excellence.
* Collaborate with experienced professionals and international stakeholders.
* Develop your technical, clinical, and leadership capabilities.
* Be part of an inclusive workplace where your expertise, individuality, and contributions are valued.

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatician
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a multidisciplinary genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for independently leading complex bioinformatics and human genetics analyses, applying robust analytical methodologies, and introducing innovative tools and approaches that enhance the organization's scientific and technical capabilities. The position contributes to translational research, scientific discovery, and publication activities through the analysis of large-scale genomic and phenotype-linked datasets.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and execution of bioinformatics analyses on large-scale human genomic datasets, including whole genome sequencing (WGS) data.
* Perform genomic analyses including variant discovery, genotype-phenotype analysis, population genetics, association studies, rare variant analysis, ancestry-aware analysis, and family-based genomic investigations.
* Analyze and interpret genomic findings within the context of human genetics, population structure, clinical phenotypes, and scientific evidence.
* Assess data quality, analytical assumptions, biases, and limitations to ensure scientific rigor and reproducibility.
* Integrate genomic, clinical, and phenotype data to support translational and clinically relevant research.
* Develop, optimize, and implement bioinformatics workflows, pipelines, and analytical methodologies.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, datasets, and analytical approaches and introduce appropriate innovations to enhance team capabilities.
* Collaborate with bioinformaticians, scientists, clinicians, researchers, and technical teams to deliver cross-functional research objectives.
* Contribute to scientific publications, manuscripts, technical reviews, presentations, and conference activities.
* Communicate analytical methods, results, risks, assumptions, and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, data governance standards, and scientific best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance analytical quality, operational efficiency, and scientific outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Human Genetics, Genomics, Computational Biology, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Extensive experience in human genomics, bioinformatics, computational biology, or biomedical data science.
* Proven experience independently leading complex genomic analysis projects.
* Experience working with large-scale genomic datasets and whole genome sequencing data.
* Strong scientific publication record preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or R.
* Hands-on experience with bioinformatics tools such as PLINK, REGENIE, bcftools, VCFtools, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of human genetics, population genomics, variant analysis, and genotype-phenotype relationships.
* Experience with clinical, phenotype, or longitudinal healthcare datasets is advantageous.
* Knowledge of OMOP, FHIR, EHR-derived phenotypes, or healthcare data standards is desirable.
* Experience with machine learning, artificial intelligence, or large language model applications in genomics is an advantage.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

* Design experiments, troubleshoot protocols, analyse results and maintain accurate, reproducible research records.
* Collaborate with veterinary and breeding teams to assess how research methods can be applied within operational conservation programmes.
* Coordinate research collaborations with external scientific partners.
* Prepare scientific publications and communicate research findings to relevant teams.

**Required Qualifications:**

* PhD in reproductive biology, veterinary or animal sciences, developmental biology, biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.
* Substantial research experience in reproductive physiology, assisted reproduction, gamete or embryo biology, reproductive cryobiology, or related cell technologies.
* Publication records relevant to the research areas covered by the role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and leading experimental research projects.
* Practical expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as gamete and embryo technologies, artificial insemination, cryopreservation or cell culture.
* Strong skills in experimental design, data analysis, protocol development and scientific documentation.
* Ability to coordinate collaborators and work effectively with scientific, veterinary and breeding teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, for reporting, data organisation and presentations.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis software and scientific data management tools.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to write scientific reports and communicate with international research partners.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Research experience with wildlife, threatened species or non-model species.
* Experience supporting operational conservation breeding programmes.
* Direct experience in IVF, embryo production and culture, embryo transfer, intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), SCNT or related cloning approaches.
* Experience in genome resource banking.
* Experience mentoring postgraduate students or junior researchers.

**About the Role**

The Research Scientist – Microalgal cultures, is responsible for developing and running the microalgal culture operations of the aquaculture research program. is responsible for the development and implementation of research projects fitting in the Center’s research directions in the topic of microalgae. The Research Scientist will develop methods to carry out hypothesis-led laboratory experiments as well as to study marine ecosystems/populations/individuals in situ. The Research Scientist – Microalgal Cultures, will also contribute in the daily operations of the YSWRR for knowledge dissemination and education.

Main responsibilities include:

* Developing and carrying out research projects aligned with the Center’s priorities
* Leading the maintenance and monitoring of multiple microalgal species
* Develop a microalgal bank of multi-species of microalgae
* Leading the quality control of microalgal stock
* Leading the production of scientific communication and articles
* Supporting the Center in its activities and contributing to its overall success
* Supervising high-school and undergraduate students
* Developing local collaborations

**Key Responsibilities**

**Developing and leading the microalgal culturing capabilities of the Center**

* Maintain and culture microalgae strains under laboratory conditions
* Optimize protocols to enhance efficiency, stability and upscaling
* Records information on appropriate production records, logs and other report forms. Provides inputs to reports as required
* Lead experiments and record relevant data
* Prepare and analyze experimental data, documenting results accurately
* Troubleshoot technical challenges related to microalgae, associated equipment and assays

**Leading research projects**

* Acts as Principal Investigator on research projects related to Microalgae to develop proposals and conduct projects; with undertaking and supervision of routine laboratory operations
* Leads the production of high-quality scientific publications, research reports, and other communication material
* Conducts research effectively by maintaining accurate records of sampling/experiments/analyses performed, conducting relevant literature searches, and maintaining an up-to-date knowledge of all current methods of experimentation
* Manages the permitting processes required to perform his/her research projects (Government Permits, etc.) under the supervision of senior researchers
* Develops collaborative research with YSWRR colleagues and actively promotes external contacts and networks for local and regional collaborations
* Develops and assists with educational initiatives and partnership, including citizen science projects and outreach events

**Management of research facility and equipment**

* Oversees supply and equipment inventory to sustain research and routine operations
* Supervises the adequate use, schedule and maintenance of the experimental laboratory equipment and facilities of the Center with production of SOPs and check lists/schedules
* Follow laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean work environment

**Support the Center’s activities**

* Supports the research training program
* Supports the rescue and research field operations when required
* Actively contributes to the outreach goals of the YSWRR
* Collaborates with SeaWorld Abu Dhabi Zoological and Education teams as required
* Contributes to the overall success of the YSWRRC projects by performing all other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Master degree in marine biology or related fields
* Minimum of 3-year experience in a research laboratory with microalgae culturing facility
* Demonstrated success in publishing research results in refereed scientific journals and peer-reviewed publications
* Evidence of effective communication skills, particularly in communicating research findings to non-academic audiences
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
* Ability to represent the Yas SeaWorld Research and Rescue Center to scientific community, general public, media, government agencies, and non-governmental associations
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated commitment to company values and safety

**Desirable**

* PhD in Marine Biology, Biotechnology or Aquaculture – with focus on Microalgae cutlures
* Previous experience in the GCC region is an advantage
* Evidence of multicultural skills in the workplace is an advantage

**Shape the Future with Us**

At Miral Experiences, we don’t just create world-class destinations - we create unforgettable memories for our guests and remarkable careers for our people.

From theme parks and attractions to guest services and behind-the-scenes roles, every member of our team plays a part in delivering exceptional experiences. We’re driven by passion, powered by innovation, and committed to excellence in everything we do.

We’re looking for passionate, driven, and talented individuals who are ready to grow, lead, and make a difference. No matter your background or expertise, there's a place for you at Miral Experiences.

jobs.title: Quality & Hygiene Coordinator

The Quality & Hygiene Coordinator is responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality assurance, food safety, hygiene, and compliance standards across all Food & Beverage operations in Dubai. The role ensures adherence to HACCP requirements, Dubai Municipality regulations, company policies, and operational standards through regular inspections, audits, training, and compliance monitoring.

The position plays a key role in promoting a culture of food safety excellence, operational consistency, and continuous improvement while ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and customer satisfaction are maintained.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Compliance

* Conduct routine quality and hygiene inspections across all operational areas.
* Monitor compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify non-conformities and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist in reviewing, updating, and implementing quality management procedures.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

Food Safety & Hygiene

* Monitor food handling, preparation, storage, transportation, and service practices.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and hygiene requirements.
* Conduct regular inspections of kitchens, storage facilities, service areas, and food outlets.
* Monitor cleaning schedules, sanitation procedures, and pest control programs.
* Verify temperature monitoring logs, food labeling, traceability records, and shelf-life controls.

Audits & Inspections

* Conduct internal audits and site compliance assessments.
* Assist departments in preparing for external audits and regulatory inspections.
* Track audit findings and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.

* Monitor employee compliance with hygiene and safety requirements.

Documentation & Reporting

* Update quality and food safety documentation as required.
* Ensure documentation is organized and readily available for audits and inspections.
* Prepare weekly and monthly compliance reports.
* Track non-conformities and monitor corrective action completion.

Incident & Risk Management

* Assist in investigating customer complaints, food safety incidents, and operational issues.

jobs.title: Scientific Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Outstanding communication abilities

**Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required**

* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Strong communication capabilities

**Education / Professional Qualifications / Certifications Required**

* Educated to a post-graduate degree (PhD or equivalent experience, MD, or Pharmacist)
* Excellent written and spoken English

Beneficial
  
  

* Appreciation of challenges of working in a complex matrix environment and proven experience of delivering results
* Active interest in controversial regulatory control issues and skills for absorbing and applying knowledge to the debate

**What we offer you?**

* We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
* Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
* Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter

**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

The Projects & Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing economic and financial feasibility studies for new and existing projects, monitoring project progress and performance, and preparing accurate and well-structured financial and management reports for senior management.

The position requires strong analytical, financial, reporting, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate and prepare professional reports in both Arabic and English.

The Projects & Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing economic and financial feasibility studies for new and existing real estate development projects, monitoring project progress and performance, and preparing accurate and well-structured financial and management reports for senior management. The role will cover the various stages of the project lifecycle, from the design and planning stage through construction, completion, and handover, including monitoring project timelines, costs, budgets, and overall performance.

The position requires strong analytical, financial, reporting, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate and prepare professional reports in both Arabic and English.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Feasibility Studies & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare comprehensive economic and financial feasibility studies for proposed projects.

• Develop project financial models, budgets, cash flow projections, revenue and cost analyses.

• Assess project profitability, financial viability, risks, and potential returns.

• Prepare financial assumptions and scenarios to support management decision-making.

• Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis where required.

**Project Monitoring & Follow-up**

• Monitor the progress of projects against approved plans, budgets, timelines, and key milestones.

• Coordinate with relevant departments, consultants, contractors, and project teams to obtain updated information.

• Identify delays, cost variations, risks, and other issues affecting project performance.

• Follow up on outstanding actions and provide management with regular updates.

• Financial & Management Reporting

• Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc project reports.

• Prepare financial performance reports, including budget versus actual analysis, project costs, revenues, cash flow, and variances.

• Consolidate project information into clear management reports.

• Highlight key issues, risks, financial implications, and required management actions.

**Reporting & Presentations**

• Prepare professional reports and presentations using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other relevant tools.

• Develop dashboards, financial summaries, charts, graphs, and management presentations.

• Present complex financial and project information in a clear and understandable format.

• Ensure all reports are accurate, consistent, professional, and properly structured.

**Bilingual Reporting**

• Prepare and present reports and management information in both Arabic and English.

• Translate and adapt financial and project-related information between Arabic and English while maintaining professional terminology and accuracy.

**Management Support**

• Provide management with timely analysis and information required for strategic and operational decisions.

• Support management in evaluating new investment and development opportunities.

• Prepare ad-hoc analysis, financial studies, presentations, and reports as requested by management.

**Key Competencies:**

* Financial Analysis & Modelling
* Feasibility Studies
* Project Monitoring & Controls
* Management Reporting
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Data Analysis
* Business Presentation
* Attention to Detail
* Communication & Coordination
* Strategic Thinking
* Arabic & English Reporting

**Skills**

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience in project analysis, financial planning, feasibility studies, project controls, or management reporting.

• Strong knowledge of financial analysis and financial modelling.

• Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including financial models, formulas, Pivot Tables, charts, and data analysis.

• Strong PowerPoint and Word presentation and report-writing skills.

• Ability to prepare professional management dashboards and presentations.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong project follow-up and coordination skills.

• Excellent written and spoken Arabic and English.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet reporting deadlines.

• Experience in real estate, construction, development, investment, or other project-based businesses would be an advantage.

jobs.title: UAE National | Part time Accountant Trainee | Airport Rd | 4pm to 8pm
jobs.description:
**Overview Of The Role:**

* The Part time Accountant is primarily responsible for supporting the multi-brand Facility, which includes showroom, service, and spare parts departments. The role is crucial in accurately recording, monitoring, and reporting financial transactions and activities associated with these departments. Reporting to the Finance Business Partner, the Accountant ensures compliance with financial processes and policies. Success is measured by the efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial reporting, cash management, and the overall integrity of account management. The position also involves supporting various teams, ensuring the sound management of accounts receivable, and contributing to operational and financial objectives.

**What You Will Do:**

Invoicing & Delivery Management

* Perform financial transactions and process invoices in a timely manner.
* Ensure all AFM document processes are strictly adhered to, ensuring all bank payments are met.
* Ensure revenue/provision processes are accurate and the assignee clause is error-free.
* Substantiate financial transactions by auditing documents.
* Record and maintain all financial operations.
* Manage intra-company and government sales transactions.
* Authorize all in-house AFM sales and credit customers.
* Produce daily invoice summaries for credit invoices and sales return cases; monitor all outstanding debts and report accordingly.
* Support and guide Matrix Managers, Sales team, and Sales Admin.

Cash (Revenue & Petty Cash Fund) Management

* Collect and verify all cash/credit card/cheque payments against invoices and post collections in SAP.
* Monitor petty cash float to ensure adequate balance and review pending reimbursements/claims for submission.
* Maintain and balance daily collection and petty cash fund twice daily.
* Monitor insurance limits of cash/collection in vault and ensure coverage from AOIC if limits are exceeded.
* Deposit all collected revenue in SCDM on the same day.
* Upload daily collection reports to the shared drive provided by the FSSC/AFSS.
* Ensure all collection/PCF verification and handovers are properly signed and filed for future reference.
* Monitor and communicate cheque clearance, bouncing cheques, and refund cheques.
* Ensure accurate data entry in SAP, keep billing cancellations and advance payments minimal, and clear and monitor cash invoices not yet collected.
* Post sublet and bought-out charges to job cards for customer billing.
* Maintain strict adherence to AFM company policy regarding customer refunds and keep a log for tracking purposes.
* Perform surprise cash counts as per SOP.

Financial Reporting, Cost & Internal Controls

* Conduct finance-related processes in compliance with AFM policies and procedures (SOPs).
* Support monitoring of Opex and Capex.
* Ensure AFM administration document processes are adhered to at all times.
* Monitor clearance of open POs and follow up with COT and showroom admin team monthly.
* Carry out ad hoc tasks/reports as required by the FBP/FM/Branch Management.

Accounts Receivables Management (AR Management)

* Review and ensure timely submission of second sets.
* Daily/weekly/monthly monitoring of branch AR report and follow-up with channels for timely collection of outstanding/overdue invoices.
* Maintain a list of all credit facilities provided to branch credit customers, including credit limit, credit period, main contact details, and credit facility documents.
* Reconcile credit customer accounts.

**Skills**

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Proficiency in SAP and financial transaction processing.
* Ability to perform detailed audits and ensure compliance with financial procedures.
* Strong skills in cash management and reporting.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Bachelor's degree in accountancy or finance.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in financial software and systems (e.g., SAP) and financial analysis.
